title: Cap. V Obj. 3 Sol close: same pattern in eternal inheritance; Hague Collation already refuted
pass_a_gloss: If in the destination and donation of the eternal inheritance we think something similar, we shall easily perceive the weakness of the aforesaid argument. I add no more, because nearly the same argument, though a little changed, was brought forward in the Hague Conference, and was formerly refuted by us.
pass_b_english: Think the same pattern in destinating and gifting the eternal inheritance, and the weakness of their argument is plain. I add no more: nearly the same argument, slightly altered, was brought at the Hague Conference and already refuted by us.
source_text: Si in aeternae haereditatis destinatione atque donatione simile quid cogitemus, facile praedicti argumenti infirmitatem perspiciemus. Plura non addo, quia idem pene argumentum, quamvis paululum immutatum, adductum fuit in Collatione Hagiensi, et a nobis antea refutatum.
